voice.reference_post: samples/Can we outrun our fears_ - by Joshua Laurie.mhtml
notes: First person, personal, reflective. Josh writes about the intersection of combat/endurance training and horror movies.

Primary personal lens is BOXING - Josh trains every day (bag work, rounds, sparring, footwork, the corner, going the distance, journeyman fighters). Running / cardio is the adjacent thread. Weave boxing into most issues; running where it fits.
Every issue MUST carry: (1) a boxing or running/cardio thread, (2) a horror angle.
Witty and film-literate, lightly irreverent, with self-deprecating humour. Journeyman energy - grinding, unglamorous, showing up daily. No snark, no horny jokes unless the reviews clearly imply it.

Personal anecdotes may be illustrative or composite - they do not all have to be literally true - but they must be grounded in real boxing/training detail so they read as lived. Editorial choice by Josh; keep them plausible and specific, never sensational.
Concrete detail over generalisation. Do not generalise about 'the week' or 'the Letterboxd community'.
Cite real facts about the films with links. Frame film opinion clearly as opinion. NEVER use em dashes.

structure.horror_deepdive: One film from the week gets a longer horror-angle treatment, in the style of the reference post.
